item.description:
6 élément(s) retenu(s) par la veille quotidienne.

Apple OS — découvertes techniques

  1. PR #77158 — Add a preference to enable EnhancedSecurity by default for system apps
    WebKit · score 11/15 · confiance élevée
    Élément modifié. Pull request, état : closed Signaux : apple, ios_tba, mac_tba, xros_tba, wk_ios_tba, wk_mac_tba, wk_xros_tba.

    #### 2b4cd37f9d483e91ec0282b7d33cdf51117fd0cc Add a preference to enable EnhancedSecurity by default for system apps https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=327709 rdar://190130548 Reviewed by Per Arne Vollan. Add an internal preference, EnhancedSecurityEnabledByDefaultForSystemApps, that makes EnhancedSecurity the default for WebViews in system apps: Apple apps that ship with the OS, excluding Safari and web apps. It is off by default, so this change has no effect until it is enabled. It can be enabled for testing with the WebKitDebugEnhancedSecurityEnabledByDefaultForSystemApps user default. Also add the opt-out mentioned in 323340@main. A

  2. PR #77753 — [css-fonts] Scale the medium font size with the user's text size under on macOS
    WebKit · score 11/15 · confiance élevée
    Nouvel élément. Pull request, état : open Signaux : apple, ios_tba, mac_tba, xros_tba, wk_ios_tba, wk_mac_tba, wk_xros_tba.

    #### 07231e84785f1f842eb01e1169a69c6241702618 [css-fonts] Follow the macOS text size setting under https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=328299 rdar://190595194 Reviewed by NOBODY (OOPS!). Pages with content="scale" already scale medium with the user's text size on iOS and visionOS. This does the same on macOS, using the same text scale factor: the Body text style size for the user's content size category divided by the Body size at the default category, snapped to the same 7 values. The web process cannot read the macOS setting, so the UI process reads it with _AXSCopyPreferredContentSizeCategoryName() and sends the category name when the

  3. PR #77659 — [Cocoa] Add a testing hook to make it possible to test WebKit's capture permission prompt
    WebKit · score 8/15 · confiance élevée
    Nouvel élément. Pull request, état : closed Signaux : ios_tba, mac_tba, wk_ios_tba, wk_mac_tba.

    #### c67dfb7221437353da3b82bd4a801af64988469e [Cocoa] Add a testing hook to make it possible to test WebKit's capture permission prompt https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=328209 rdar://190525284 Reviewed by Jer Noble. When a UI delegate answers a getUserMedia request with WKPermissionDecisionPrompt, WebKit shows its own NSAlert or UIAlertController. API tests can't press its buttons, so none of that path is tested. Add -[WKWebView _setMediaCapturePermissionPromptHandlerForTesting:]. While a handler is set, the prompt isn't shown. The handler instead gets a _WKMediaCapturePermissionPromptForTesting with the prompt's title and button title

  4. PR #77704 — Refactoring: Introducing ENABLE(LIB_JSC_TOOLS).
    WebKit · score 7/15 · confiance élevée
    Nouvel élément. Pull request, état : closed Signaux : apple, apple_internal_sdk.

    #### 4d44245d61b1bc030ff8290a7e721da62c6100af Refactoring: Introducing ENABLE(LIB_JSC_TOOLS). https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=328255 rdar://190554248 Reviewed by Justin Michaud and Vassili Bykov. This is so that we don't have to continually do this everywhere: `#if (OS(MACOS) || USE(APPLE_INTERNAL_SDK)) && !PLATFORM(MACCATALYST) && !PLATFORM(IOS_FAMILY_SIMULATOR)` No new tests because this is a refactoring change only.
